title: Selma Leaves the Flowers for the Bees
youtube_title: Selma Leaves the Flowers for the Bees | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Caring for nature means leaving enough of the meadow for the creatures who live there.
summary: Selma wants a large bouquet for the table. Watching bees from the path, she sees that the flowers are their pantry. She picks none of the busy blooms, makes a paper bouquet instead, and learns that loving a meadow can mean leaving it as it is.
